## Change Type

- [ ] Add resource
- [ ] Fix dead link
- [ ] Remove deprecated resource
- [ ] Reorganize category
- [ ] Maintenance/tooling

## What Changed

Describe the resource or maintenance change in one or two precise sentences.

## Curation Check

- [ ] URL is working or the dead-link reason is explained.
- [ ] Resource is in the most useful category.
- [ ] Description matches the surrounding README style.
- [ ] Duplicate check against `README.md` is complete.
- [ ] Change is small enough to review safely.

## Evidence

Add any relevant notes: replacement URL, upstream move, deprecation notice, issue/PR number, or link-check output.
